suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(TCGAbiolinks)

projects <- c(
    "TCGA-COAD",

)

data_dir <- "data"

maf_cache <- file.path(

    "tcga_coad_read_ucec_masked_maf.rds"

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(VariantAnnotation)
    library(GenomicRanges)
    library(GenomeInfoDb)
    library(Rsamtools)
})





download_tcga_maf <- function(project, data_dir = "data") {

    message("Processing ", project)

    project_dir <- file.path(data_dir, project)
    dir.create(
        project_dir,
        recursive = TRUE,
        showWarnings = FALSE
    )

    query <- GDCquery(
        project = project,
        data.category = "Simple Nucleotide Variation",
        data.type = "Masked Somatic Mutation",
        workflow.type =
            "Aliquot Ensemble Somatic Variant Merging and Masking",
        access = "open"
    )

    GDCdownload(
        query,
        method = "api",
        directory = project_dir,
        files.per.chunk = 10
    )

    maf <- GDCprepare(
        query,
        directory = project_dir
    )

    maf <- as.data.frame(maf)
    maf$TCGA_project <- project

    message(
        project,
        ": loaded ",
        format(nrow(maf), big.mark = ","),
        " mutation records"
    )

    maf
}


add_missing_column <- function(data, column, value = NA) {

    if (!column %in% colnames(data)) {
        data[[column]] <- value
    }

    data
}


safe_numeric <- function(x) {
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
}


extract_aa_position <- function(hgvsp_short, hgvsp) {

    protein_change <- dplyr::coalesce(
        as.character(hgvsp_short),
        as.character(hgvsp)
    )

    position <- stringr::str_match(
        protein_change,
        "p\\.[A-Za-z*]+([0-9]+)"
    )[, 2]

    suppressWarnings(as.integer(position))
}


collapse_info_value <- function(x) {

    if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
        return(NA_character_)
    }

    paste(
        unique(as.character(x[!is.na(x)])),
        collapse = ";"
    )
}





if (file.exists(maf_cache) && file.info(maf_cache)$size > 0) {

    message("Reading cached TCGA MAF object: ", maf_cache)
    maf_all <- readRDS(maf_cache)

} else {

    maf_list <- setNames(
        lapply(
            projects,
            download_tcga_maf,
            data_dir = data_dir
        ),
        projects
    )

    maf_all <- bind_rows(maf_list)

    saveRDS(
        maf_all,
        maf_cache
    )
}

message(
    "Combined MAF contains ",
    format(nrow(maf_all), big.mark = ","),
    " mutation records"
)





required_columns <- c(
    "Hugo_Symbol",
    "Chromosome",
    "Start_Position",
    "End_Position",
    "Reference_Allele",
    "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
    "Variant_Classification",
    "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
    "TCGA_project"
)

missing_required <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    colnames(maf_all)
)

if (length(missing_required) > 0) {
    stop(
        "Required MAF columns are missing: ",
        paste(missing_required, collapse = ", ")
    )
}

optional_columns <- c(
    "Tumor_Seq_Allele1",
    "Variant_Type",
    "Matched_Norm_Sample_Barcode",
    "HGVSc",
    "HGVSp",
    "HGVSp_Short",
    "Transcript_ID",
    "Consequence",
    "IMPACT",
    "FILTER",
    "t_alt_count",
    "t_ref_count",
    "n_alt_count",
    "n_ref_count",
    "Existing_variation",
    "CLIN_SIG",
    "SIFT",
    "PolyPhen"
)

for (column in optional_columns) {
    maf_all <- add_missing_column(
        maf_all,
        column,
        NA
    )
}





all_patients <- maf_all %>%
    transmute(
        TCGA_project,
        Tumor_Sample_Barcode =
            as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
        patient_id =
            substr(as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode), 1, 12),
        cancer_type = case_when(
            TCGA_project %in% c("TCGA-COAD", "TCGA-READ") ~
                "CRC",
            TCGA_project == "TCGA-UCEC" ~
                "UCEC",
            TRUE ~ TCGA_project
        )
    ) %>%
    distinct(
        TCGA_project,
        patient_id,
        .keep_all = TRUE
    )





polymerase_variants <- maf_all %>%
    filter(
        Hugo_Symbol %in% c("POLE", "POLD1")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        Tumor_Sample_Barcode =
            as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),

        patient_id =
            substr(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12),

        cancer_type = case_when(
            TCGA_project %in% c("TCGA-COAD", "TCGA-READ") ~
                "CRC",
            TCGA_project == "TCGA-UCEC" ~
                "UCEC",
            TRUE ~ TCGA_project
        ),

        Chromosome =
            str_remove(as.character(Chromosome), "^chr"),

        Start_Position =
            safe_numeric(Start_Position),

        End_Position =
            safe_numeric(End_Position),

        Reference_Allele =
            as.character(Reference_Allele),

        Tumor_Seq_Allele2 =
            as.character(Tumor_Seq_Allele2),

        t_ref_count =
            safe_numeric(t_ref_count),

        t_alt_count =
            safe_numeric(t_alt_count),

        n_ref_count =
            safe_numeric(n_ref_count),

        n_alt_count =
            safe_numeric(n_alt_count)
    ) %>%
    distinct(
        TCGA_project,
        Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
        Hugo_Symbol,
        Chromosome,
        Start_Position,
        Reference_Allele,
        Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
        .keep_all = TRUE
    )

if (nrow(polymerase_variants) == 0) {
    stop("No POLE or POLD1 variants were found.")
}





polymerase_variants <- polymerase_variants %>%
    mutate(
        tumor_depth = t_ref_count + t_alt_count,

        tumor_vaf = if_else(
            !is.na(t_alt_count) &
                !is.na(t_ref_count) &
                tumor_depth > 0,
            t_alt_count / tumor_depth,
            NA_real_
        ),

        normal_depth = n_ref_count + n_alt_count,

        normal_vaf = if_else(
            !is.na(n_alt_count) &
                !is.na(n_ref_count) &
                normal_depth > 0,
            n_alt_count / normal_depth,
            NA_real_
        ),

        amino_acid_position = extract_aa_position(
            HGVSp_Short,
            HGVSp
        )
    )








polymerase_variants <- polymerase_variants %>%
    mutate(
        exonuclease_domain = case_when(
            Hugo_Symbol == "POLE" &
                amino_acid_position >= 268 &
                amino_acid_position <= 471 ~ TRUE,

            Hugo_Symbol == "POLD1" &
                amino_acid_position >= 304 &
                amino_acid_position <= 517 ~ TRUE,

            !is.na(amino_acid_position) ~ FALSE,

            TRUE ~ NA
        ),

        domain_annotation = case_when(
            exonuclease_domain %in% TRUE ~
                "Exonuclease domain",

            exonuclease_domain %in% FALSE ~
                "Outside exonuclease domain",

            TRUE ~
                "Protein position unavailable"
        ),

        coding_effect_group = case_when(
            Variant_Classification %in% c(
                "Nonsense_Mutation",
                "Frame_Shift_Del",
                "Frame_Shift_Ins",
                "Splice_Site",
                "Translation_Start_Site"
            ) ~ "Protein-truncating/splice",

            Variant_Classification %in% c(
                "Missense_Mutation",
                "In_Frame_Del",
                "In_Frame_Ins"
            ) ~ "Protein-altering",

            Variant_Classification == "Silent" ~
                "Synonymous",

            TRUE ~
                "Other"
        )
    )





variant_recurrence <- polymerase_variants %>%
    group_by(
        Hugo_Symbol,
        Chromosome,
        Start_Position,
        Reference_Allele,
        Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
        HGVSp_Short
    ) %>%
    summarise(
        n_patients_all_projects =
            n_distinct(patient_id),

        projects_present =
            paste(
                sort(unique(TCGA_project)),
                collapse = ";"
            ),

        patient_ids =
            paste(
                sort(unique(patient_id)),
                collapse = ";"
            ),

        .groups = "drop"
    )

polymerase_variants <- polymerase_variants %>%
    left_join(
        variant_recurrence,
        by = c(
            "Hugo_Symbol",
            "Chromosome",
            "Start_Position",
            "Reference_Allele",
            "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
            "HGVSp_Short"
        )
    )








known_pole_hotspots <- c(
    "p.P286R",
    "p.S297F",
    "p.V411L",
    "p.L424F",
    "p.L424V"
)

polymerase_variants <- polymerase_variants %>%
    mutate(
        known_recurrent_pole_hotspot =
            Hugo_Symbol == "POLE" &
            HGVSp_Short %in% known_pole_hotspots
    )





clinvar_vcf_gz <- file.path(
    clinvar_dir,
    "clinvar_GRCh38.vcf.gz"
)

clinvar_tbi <- paste0(
    clinvar_vcf_gz,
    ".tbi"
)

clinvar_vcf_url <- paste0(
    "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/",
    "vcf_GRCh38/clinvar.vcf.gz"
)

clinvar_tbi_url <- paste0(
    "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/",
    "vcf_GRCh38/clinvar.vcf.gz.tbi"
)

if (
    !file.exists(clinvar_vcf_gz) ||
    file.info(clinvar_vcf_gz)$size == 0
) {
    message("Downloading ClinVar GRCh38 VCF")

    download.file(
        clinvar_vcf_url,
        destfile = clinvar_vcf_gz,
        mode = "wb"
    )
}

if (
    !file.exists(clinvar_tbi) ||
    file.info(clinvar_tbi)$size == 0
) {
    message("Downloading ClinVar GRCh38 index")

    download.file(
        clinvar_tbi_url,
        destfile = clinvar_tbi,
        mode = "wb"
    )
}





clinvar_tabix <- TabixFile(
    clinvar_vcf_gz,
    index = clinvar_tbi
)

clinvar_contigs <- seqnamesTabix(
    clinvar_tabix
)

clinvar_uses_chr_prefix <- any(
    str_detect(clinvar_contigs, "^chr")
)

regions <- polymerase_variants %>%
    transmute(
        chromosome =
            str_remove(as.character(Chromosome), "^chr"),

        Start_Position =
            as.integer(Start_Position),

        End_Position =
            as.integer(End_Position)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        chromosome = if (clinvar_uses_chr_prefix) {
            paste0("chr", chromosome)
        } else {
            chromosome
        }
    ) %>%
    filter(
        !is.na(chromosome),
        !is.na(Start_Position),
        !is.na(End_Position),
        chromosome %in% clinvar_contigs
    ) %>%
    group_by(chromosome) %>%
    summarise(
        start = max(
            1L,
            min(Start_Position, na.rm = TRUE) - 1000L
        ),

        end =
            max(End_Position, na.rm = TRUE) + 1000L,

        .groups = "drop"
    )

if (nrow(regions) == 0) {
    stop(
        "No TCGA chromosome names matched the ClinVar index. ",
        "ClinVar contigs begin with: ",
        paste(head(clinvar_contigs), collapse = ", ")
    )
}

regions_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = regions$chromosome,
    ranges = IRanges(
        start = regions$start,
        end = regions$end
    )
)

message(
    "Reading ClinVar regions: ",
    paste(
        paste0(
            regions$chromosome,
            ":",
            regions$start,
            "-",
            regions$end
        ),
        collapse = ", "
    )
)





clinvar_vcf <- readVcf(
    clinvar_tabix,
    genome = "GRCh38",
    param = ScanVcfParam(
        which = regions_gr,
        info = c(
            "CLNSIG",
            "CLNREVSTAT",
            "CLNDN",
            "ALLELEID"
        )
    )
)



clinvar_expanded <- expand(
    clinvar_vcf,
    row.names = TRUE
)

clinvar_info <- info(clinvar_expanded)

clinvar_table <- tibble(
    Chromosome = str_remove(
        as.character(
            seqnames(rowRanges(clinvar_expanded))
        ),
        "^chr"
    ),

    Start_Position =
        as.integer(start(rowRanges(clinvar_expanded))),

    Reference_Allele =
        as.character(ref(clinvar_expanded)),

    Tumor_Seq_Allele2 =
        as.character(unlist(alt(clinvar_expanded))),

    ClinVar_significance =
        vapply(
            clinvar_info$CLNSIG,
            collapse_info_value,
            character(1)
        ),

    ClinVar_review_status =
        vapply(
            clinvar_info$CLNREVSTAT,
            collapse_info_value,
            character(1)
        ),

    ClinVar_condition =
        vapply(
            clinvar_info$CLNDN,
            collapse_info_value,
            character(1)
        ),

    ClinVar_allele_id =
        vapply(
            clinvar_info$ALLELEID,
            collapse_info_value,
            character(1)
        )
) %>%
    distinct()





polymerase_variants <- polymerase_variants %>%
    left_join(
        clinvar_table,
        by = c(
            "Chromosome",
            "Start_Position",
            "Reference_Allele",
            "Tumor_Seq_Allele2"
        )
    )









polymerase_variants <- polymerase_variants %>%
    mutate(
        gdc_clinical_significance =
            as.character(CLIN_SIG),

        clinvar_pathogenic = str_detect(
            coalesce(ClinVar_significance, ""),
            regex(
                "pathogenic",
                ignore_case = TRUE
            )
        ) &
            !str_detect(
                coalesce(ClinVar_significance, ""),
                regex(
                    "conflicting",
                    ignore_case = TRUE
                )
            ),

        clinvar_vus = str_detect(
            coalesce(ClinVar_significance, ""),
            regex(
                "uncertain",
                ignore_case = TRUE
            )
        ),

        provisional_polymerase_class = case_when(
            known_recurrent_pole_hotspot ~
                "Known recurrent POLE proofreading hotspot",

            clinvar_pathogenic &
                exonuclease_domain %in% TRUE ~
                paste0(
                    "ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic ",
                    "exonuclease-domain variant"
                ),

            exonuclease_domain %in% TRUE &
                coding_effect_group == "Protein-altering" ~
                paste0(
                    "Exonuclease-domain protein-altering ",
                    "variant requiring manual review"
                ),

            clinvar_vus &
                exonuclease_domain %in% TRUE ~
                "Exonuclease-domain VUS",

            clinvar_vus ~
                "ClinVar VUS outside/unknown domain",

            coding_effect_group ==
                "Protein-truncating/splice" ~
                "Truncating/splice variant requiring manual review",

            TRUE ~
                "Other POLE/POLD1 variant"
        ),

        likely_proofreading_relevant = case_when(
            known_recurrent_pole_hotspot ~ TRUE,

            clinvar_pathogenic &
                exonuclease_domain %in% TRUE ~ TRUE,

            TRUE ~ FALSE
        ),

        literature_evidence =
            NA_character_,

        mutational_signature_support =
            NA_character_,

        final_manual_classification =
            NA_character_,

        final_classification_reason =
            NA_character_
    )





polymerase_variant_table <- polymerase_variants %>%
     dplyr::select(
        TCGA_project,
        cancer_type,
        patient_id,
        Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
        Matched_Norm_Sample_Barcode,

        Hugo_Symbol,
        Chromosome,
        Start_Position,
        End_Position,
        Reference_Allele,
        Tumor_Seq_Allele1,
        Tumor_Seq_Allele2,

        Variant_Classification,
        Variant_Type,
        coding_effect_group,
        Consequence,
        IMPACT,
        FILTER,

        HGVSc,
        HGVSp,
        HGVSp_Short,
        Transcript_ID,
        amino_acid_position,
        exonuclease_domain,
        domain_annotation,
        known_recurrent_pole_hotspot,

        t_ref_count,
        t_alt_count,
        tumor_depth,
        tumor_vaf,
        n_ref_count,
        n_alt_count,
        normal_depth,
        normal_vaf,

        Existing_variation,
        SIFT,
        PolyPhen,
        gdc_clinical_significance,

        ClinVar_significance,
        ClinVar_review_status,
        ClinVar_condition,
        ClinVar_allele_id,

        n_patients_all_projects,
        projects_present,
        patient_ids,

        clinvar_pathogenic,
        clinvar_vus,
        likely_proofreading_relevant,
        provisional_polymerase_class,

        literature_evidence,
        mutational_signature_support,
        final_manual_classification,
        final_classification_reason
    ) %>%
    arrange(
        TCGA_project,
        patient_id,
        Hugo_Symbol,
        amino_acid_position
    )





patient_polymerase_summary <- polymerase_variant_table %>%
    group_by(
        TCGA_project,
        cancer_type,
        patient_id
    ) %>%
    summarise(
        n_pole_variants =
            sum(Hugo_Symbol == "POLE"),

        n_pold1_variants =
            sum(Hugo_Symbol == "POLD1"),

        n_total_polymerase_variants =
            n(),

        has_pole_mutation =
            any(Hugo_Symbol == "POLE"),

        has_pold1_mutation =
            any(Hugo_Symbol == "POLD1"),

        has_exonuclease_domain_variant =
            any(
                exonuclease_domain %in% TRUE,
                na.rm = TRUE
            ),

        has_known_pole_hotspot =
            any(
                known_recurrent_pole_hotspot,
                na.rm = TRUE
            ),

        has_clinvar_pathogenic_exonuclease_variant =
            any(
                clinvar_pathogenic &
                    exonuclease_domain %in% TRUE,
                na.rm = TRUE
            ),

        likely_proofreading_relevant =
            any(
                likely_proofreading_relevant,
                na.rm = TRUE
            ),

        genes_mutated =
            paste(
                sort(unique(Hugo_Symbol)),
                collapse = ";"
            ),

        protein_changes =
            paste(
                sort(
                    unique(
                        na.omit(HGVSp_Short)
                    )
                ),
                collapse = ";"
            ),

        provisional_classes =
            paste(
                sort(
                    unique(
                        provisional_polymerase_class
                    )
                ),
                collapse = ";"
            ),

        patient_polymerase_status = case_when(
            any(
                known_recurrent_pole_hotspot,
                na.rm = TRUE
            ) ~
                "Known recurrent POLE proofreading hotspot",

            any(
                clinvar_pathogenic &
                    exonuclease_domain %in% TRUE,
                na.rm = TRUE
            ) ~
                paste0(
                    "ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic ",
                    "exonuclease-domain variant"
                ),

            any(
                exonuclease_domain %in% TRUE &
                    coding_effect_group ==
                    "Protein-altering",
                na.rm = TRUE
            ) ~
                paste0(
                    "Exonuclease-domain protein-altering ",
                    "variant requiring manual review"
                ),

            TRUE ~
                "Other POLE/POLD1 variant"
        ),

        .groups = "drop"
    )


patient_status_all <- all_patients %>%
    left_join(
        patient_polymerase_summary,
        by = c(
            "TCGA_project",
            "cancer_type",
            "patient_id"
        )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        across(
            c(
                n_pole_variants,
                n_pold1_variants,
                n_total_polymerase_variants
            ),
            ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
        ),

        across(
            c(
                has_pole_mutation,
                has_pold1_mutation,
                has_exonuclease_domain_variant,
                has_known_pole_hotspot,
                has_clinvar_pathogenic_exonuclease_variant,
                likely_proofreading_relevant
            ),
            ~ replace_na(.x, FALSE)
        ),

        patient_polymerase_status = replace_na(
            patient_polymerase_status,
            "No POLE/POLD1 mutation"
        ),

        genes_mutated = replace_na(
            genes_mutated,
            ""
        ),

        protein_changes = replace_na(
            protein_changes,
            ""
        ),

        provisional_classes = replace_na(
            provisional_classes,
            ""
        )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
        TCGA_project,
        patient_id
    )





cohort_status_summary <- patient_status_all %>%
    dplyr::count(
        TCGA_project,
        cancer_type,
        patient_polymerase_status,
        name = "n_patients"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
        TCGA_project,
        cancer_type
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        total_patients = sum(n_patients),
        percentage = 100 * n_patients / total_patients
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
        TCGA_project,
        desc(n_patients)
    )





clinvar_unmatched_variants <- polymerase_variant_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
        is.na(ClinVar_significance)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
        TCGA_project,
        patient_id,
        Hugo_Symbol,
        Chromosome,
        Start_Position,
        End_Position,
        Reference_Allele,
        Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
        HGVSc,
        HGVSp_Short,
        Variant_Classification,
        domain_annotation,
        provisional_polymerase_class
    )





write_csv(
    polymerase_variant_table,
    file.path(
        output_dir,
        "TCGA_COAD_READ_UCEC_POLE_POLD1_variants.csv"
    ),
    na = ""
)

saveRDS(
    polymerase_variant_table,
    file.path(
        output_dir,
        "TCGA_COAD_READ_UCEC_POLE_POLD1_variants.rds"
    )
)

write_csv(
    patient_status_all,
    file.path(
        output_dir,
        "TCGA_COAD_READ_UCEC_patient_polymerase_status.csv"
    ),
    na = ""
)

saveRDS(
    patient_status_all,
    file.path(
        output_dir,
        "TCGA_COAD_READ_UCEC_patient_polymerase_status.rds"
    )
)

write_csv(
    cohort_status_summary,
    file.path(
        output_dir,
        "TCGA_COAD_READ_UCEC_polymerase_status_summary.csv"
    ),
    na = ""
)

write_csv(
    clinvar_unmatched_variants,
    file.path(
        output_dir,
        "TCGA_POLE_POLD1_variants_without_exact_ClinVar_match.csv"
    ),
    na = ""
)

writeLines(
    sort(colnames(maf_all)),
    file.path(
        output_dir,
        "available_MAF_columns.txt"
    )
)





cat("\nPOLE/POLD1 mutation-level table:\n")
print(

read_saved_table <- function(
    rds_file,
    csv_file,
    object_name
) {
    if (
        file.exists(rds_file) &&
        file.info(rds_file)$size > 0
    ) {
        message(
            "Reading ",
            object_name,
            " from ",
            rds_file
        )

        return(readRDS(rds_file))
    }

    if (
        file.exists(csv_file) &&
        file.info(csv_file)$size > 0
    ) {
        message(
            "Reading ",
            object_name,
            " from ",
            csv_file
        )

        return(
            readr::read_csv(
                csv_file,
                show_col_types = FALSE
            )
        )
    }

    stop(
        "Could not find the saved ",
        object_name,
        ". Expected either:\n",
        rds_file,
        "\n",
        csv_file
    )
}

find_one_file <- function(pattern, search_directory = ".") {

    matches <- list.files(
        path = search_directory,
        pattern = pattern,
        recursive = TRUE,
        full.names = TRUE,
        ignore.case = TRUE
    )

    matches <- matches[
        file.exists(matches) &
            file.info(matches)$size > 0
    ]

    if (length(matches) == 0) {
        return(NA_character_)
    }

    if (length(matches) > 1) {
        message(
            "Several files matched '",
            pattern,
            "'. Using:\n",
            matches[[1]]
        )
    }

    matches[[1]]
}

patient_status_rds <- find_one_file(
    "patient_polymerase_status\\.rds$"
)

patient_status_csv <- find_one_file(
    "patient_polymerase_status\\.csv$"
)

variant_table_rds <- find_one_file(
    "POLE_POLD1.*variants\\.rds$"
)

variant_table_csv <- find_one_file(

)

read_rds_or_csv <- function(
    rds_file,
    csv_file,
    object_description
) {

    if (!is.na(rds_file)) {
        message(
            "Reading ",
            object_description,
            ":\n",
            rds_file
        )

        return(readRDS(rds_file))
    }

    if (!is.na(csv_file)) {
        message(
            "Reading ",
            object_description,
            ":\n",
            csv_file
        )

        return(
            readr::read_csv(
                csv_file,
                show_col_types = FALSE
            )
        )
    }

    stop(
        "Could not find ",
        object_description,
        ".\nExpected a saved RDS or CSV file from the previous analysis."
    )
}

prepare_clinical <- function(data, default_project = NA_character_) {

    project_value <- if ("project_id" %in% colnames(data)) {
        as.character(data$project_id)
    } else {
        rep(default_project, nrow(data))
    }

    data %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            sample_id = substr(
                as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
                1,
                15
            ),
            patient_id = substr(
                as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
                1,
                12
            ),
            TCGA_project = project_value,
            MSI_TMB = stringr::str_trim(
                as.character(MSI_TMB)
            )
        ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
            !is.na(sample_id),
            sample_id != ""
        ) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(
            sample_id,
            .keep_all = TRUE
        )
}

    clinical_crc
)

    clinical_ucec,
    default_project = "TCGA-UCEC"
)

read_ssgsea_matrix <- function(
    filename,
    expected_project
) {

    raw <- utils::read.csv(
        filename,
        row.names = 1,
        check.names = FALSE
    )

    required_pathways <- c(
        "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING",
        "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS",
        "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT"
    )

    missing_pathways <- setdiff(
        required_pathways,
        rownames(raw)
    )

    if (length(missing_pathways) > 0) {
        stop(
            basename(filename),
            " is missing pathways: ",
            paste(missing_pathways, collapse = ", ")
        )
    }

    pathway_matrix <- raw[
        required_pathways,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
    ]

    pathway_table <- as.data.frame(
        t(as.matrix(pathway_matrix)),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    pathway_table$sample_id <- rownames(pathway_table)
    rownames(pathway_table) <- NULL

    pathway_table %>%
        tibble::as_tibble() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            sample_id = substr(
                as.character(sample_id),
                1,
                15
            ),
            patient_id = substr(
                sample_id,
                1,
                12
            ),
            pathway_project = expected_project,
            dplyr::across(
                dplyr::all_of(required_pathways),
                as.numeric
            )
        )
}

gsva_crc <- read_ssgsea_matrix(

    expected_project = "TCGA-COAD/READ"

to_logical <- function(x) {

    if (is.logical(x)) {
        return(x)
    }

    value <- stringr::str_to_lower(
        stringr::str_trim(as.character(x))
    )

    dplyr::case_when(
        value %in% c("true", "t", "1", "yes") ~ TRUE,
        value %in% c("false", "f", "0", "no") ~ FALSE,
        TRUE ~ NA
    )
}

possible_pole_columns <- c(
    "has_pole_mutation",
    "pole_mutated"
)

possible_pold1_columns <- c(
    "has_pold1_mutation",
    "pold1_mutated"
)

pole_column <- intersect(
    possible_pole_columns,
    colnames(patient_status_all)
)[1]

pold1_column <- intersect(
    possible_pold1_columns,
    colnames(patient_status_all)
)[1]

if (is.na(pole_column) || is.na(pold1_column)) {
    stop(
        "Could not identify POLE/POLD1 mutation columns in patient_status_all.\n",
        "Available columns:\n",
        paste(colnames(patient_status_all), collapse = ", ")
    )
}

patient_status_prepared <- patient_status_all %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        pole_mutated = to_logical(
            .data[[pole_column]]
        ),
        pold1_mutated = to_logical(
            .data[[pold1_column]]
        ),
        pole_mutated = tidyr::replace_na(
            pole_mutated,
            FALSE
        ),
        pold1_mutated = tidyr::replace_na(
            pold1_mutated,
            FALSE
        ),
        polymerase_group = dplyr::case_when(
            pole_mutated & pold1_mutated ~
                "POLE/POLD1 double-mutant",

            pole_mutated ~
                "POLE-mutant",

            pold1_mutated ~
                "POLD1-mutant",

            TRUE ~
                "Polymerase wild-type"
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
        patient_id,
        dplyr::any_of(c(
            "TCGA_project",
            "cancer_type",
            "patient_polymerase_status"
        )),
        pole_mutated,
        pold1_mutated,
        polymerase_group,
        dplyr::everything()
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
        patient_id,
        .keep_all = TRUE
    )





polymerase_variant_table <- polymerase_variant_table %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        patient_id = substr(
            as.character(patient_id),
            1,
            12
        )
    )

clinvar_column <- intersect(
    c(
        "ClinVar_significance",
        "clinvar_significance",
        "CLNSIG"
    ),
    colnames(polymerase_variant_table)
)[1]

if (is.na(clinvar_column)) {

    warning(
        "No ClinVar significance column was found. ",
        "Variants will be labelled as unclassified."
    )

    polymerase_variant_table$clinical_annotation <-
        NA_character_

} else {

    polymerase_variant_table$clinical_annotation <-
        as.character(
            polymerase_variant_table[[clinvar_column]]
        )
}

polymerase_variant_classification <-
    polymerase_variant_table %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        clinical_annotation_clean =
            stringr::str_to_lower(
                tidyr::replace_na(
                    clinical_annotation,
                    ""
                )
            ),

        variant_clinical_class =
            dplyr::case_when(
                stringr::str_detect(
                    clinical_annotation_clean,
                    "pathogenic"
                ) &
                    !stringr::str_detect(
                        clinical_annotation_clean,
                        "conflicting"
                    ) ~
                    "Pathogenic/likely pathogenic",

                stringr::str_detect(
                    clinical_annotation_clean,
                    "uncertain|vus"
                ) ~
                    "VUS",

                clinical_annotation_clean != "" ~
                    "Other ClinVar classification",

                TRUE ~
                    "Not classified"
            )
    )


hgvsp_column <- intersect(
    c("HGVSp_Short", "HGVSp"),
    colnames(polymerase_variant_classification)
)[1]

if (is.na(hgvsp_column)) {
    polymerase_variant_classification$protein_change_value <- NA_character_
} else {
    polymerase_variant_classification$protein_change_value <-
        as.character(
            polymerase_variant_classification[[hgvsp_column]]
        )
}

variant_patient_summary <-
    polymerase_variant_classification %>%
    dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
        has_pathogenic_pole = any(
            Hugo_Symbol == "POLE" &
                variant_clinical_class ==
                "Pathogenic/likely pathogenic",
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        has_pathogenic_pold1 = any(
            Hugo_Symbol == "POLD1" &
                variant_clinical_class ==
                "Pathogenic/likely pathogenic",
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        has_pole_vus = any(
            Hugo_Symbol == "POLE" &
                variant_clinical_class == "VUS",
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        has_pold1_vus = any(
            Hugo_Symbol == "POLD1" &
                variant_clinical_class == "VUS",
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        mutated_genes = paste(
            sort(
                unique(
                    stats::na.omit(
                        as.character(Hugo_Symbol)
                    )
                )
            ),
            collapse = ";"
        ),

        protein_changes = {
            values <- unique(
                stats::na.omit(
                    protein_change_value
                )
            )

            if (length(values) == 0) {
                ""
            } else {
                paste(
                    sort(values),
                    collapse = ";"
                )
            }
        },

        clinvar_classes = paste(
            sort(
                unique(
                    stats::na.omit(
                        as.character(
                            variant_clinical_class
                        )
                    )
                )
            ),
            collapse = ";"
        ),

        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        detailed_polymerase_class =
            dplyr::case_when(
                has_pathogenic_pole &
                    has_pathogenic_pold1 ~
                    "POLE/POLD1 pathogenic",

                has_pathogenic_pole ~
                    "POLE pathogenic/likely pathogenic",

                has_pathogenic_pold1 ~
                    "POLD1 pathogenic/likely pathogenic",

                has_pole_vus &
                    has_pold1_vus ~
                    "POLE/POLD1 VUS",

                has_pole_vus ~
                    "POLE VUS",

                has_pold1_vus ~
                    "POLD1 VUS",

                TRUE ~
                    "Other or unclassified mutation"
            )
    )

patient_status_prepared <-
    patient_status_prepared %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
        variant_patient_summary,
        by = "patient_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        detailed_polymerase_class =
            dplyr::case_when(
                polymerase_group ==
                    "Polymerase wild-type" ~
                    "Polymerase wild-type",

                !is.na(detailed_polymerase_class) ~
                    detailed_polymerase_class,

                TRUE ~
                    "Other or unclassified mutation"
            ),

        any_pathogenic_polymerase =
            tidyr::replace_na(
                has_pathogenic_pole,
                FALSE
            ) |
            tidyr::replace_na(
                has_pathogenic_pold1,
                FALSE
            ),

        any_polymerase_vus =
            tidyr::replace_na(
                has_pole_vus,
                FALSE
            ) |
            tidyr::replace_na(
                has_pold1_vus,
                FALSE
            )
    )





analysis_all <- gsva_all %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
        clinical_all,
        by = c(
            "sample_id",
            "patient_id"
        ),
        suffix = c("_gsva", "_clinical")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
        patient_status_prepared,
        by = "patient_id",

safe_kruskal <- function(data) {

    usable <- data %>%
        dplyr::filter(
            !is.na(pathway_score),
            !is.na(polymerase_group)
        ) %>%
        droplevels()

    if (
        nrow(usable) < 3 ||
        dplyr::n_distinct(
            usable$polymerase_group
        ) < 2
    ) {
        return(
            tibble::tibble(
                statistic = NA_real_,
                degrees_of_freedom = NA_real_,
                p_value = NA_real_,
                note = "Insufficient groups"
            )
        )
    }

    result <- stats::kruskal.test(
        pathway_score ~ polymerase_group,
        data = usable
    )

    tibble::tibble(
        statistic = unname(result$statistic),
        degrees_of_freedom =
            unname(result$parameter),
        p_value = result$p.value,
        note = NA_character_
    )
}

kruskal_results <- mss_tmbh_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
        cancer_group,
        pathway
    ) %>%
    tidyr::nest() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        result = purrr::map(
            data,
            safe_kruskal
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-data) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(result) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        p_adjusted_BH = stats::p.adjust(
            p_value,
            method = "BH"
        )
    )

readr::write_csv(
    kruskal_results,
    file.path(

    na = ""

mss_tmbh_binary <- mss_tmbh_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        polymerase_binary = factor(
            dplyr::if_else(
                polymerase_group ==

                "Polymerase wild-type",
                "POLE/POLD1-mutant"
            ),
            levels = c(
                "Polymerase wild-type",
                "POLE/POLD1-mutant"
            )
        )
    )

safe_wilcox <- function(data) {

    usable <- data %>%
        dplyr::filter(
            !is.na(pathway_score),
            !is.na(polymerase_binary)
        )

    group_counts <- table(
        usable$polymerase_binary
    )

    if (
        length(group_counts) < 2 ||
        any(group_counts == 0)
    ) {
        return(
            tibble::tibble(
                n_wildtype = sum(
                    usable$polymerase_binary ==
                        "Polymerase wild-type"
                ),
                n_mutant = sum(
                    usable$polymerase_binary ==
                        "POLE/POLD1-mutant"
                ),
                median_wildtype = NA_real_,
                median_mutant = NA_real_,
                median_difference = NA_real_,
                p_value = NA_real_,
                note = "Insufficient groups"
            )
        )
    }

    wt <- usable$pathway_score[
        usable$polymerase_binary ==
            "Polymerase wild-type"
    ]

    mutant <- usable$pathway_score[
        usable$polymerase_binary ==
            "POLE/POLD1-mutant"
    ]

    result <- stats::wilcox.test(
        mutant,
        wt,
        exact = FALSE
    )

    tibble::tibble(
        n_wildtype = length(wt),
        n_mutant = length(mutant),
        median_wildtype = median(
            wt,
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        median_mutant = median(
            mutant,
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        median_difference =
            median(mutant, na.rm = TRUE) -
            median(wt, na.rm = TRUE),
        p_value = result$p.value,
        note = NA_character_
    )
}

wilcox_results <- mss_tmbh_binary %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
        cancer_group,
        pathway
    ) %>%
    tidyr::nest() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        result = purrr::map(
            data,
            safe_wilcox
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-data) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(result) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        p_adjusted_BH = stats::p.adjust(
            p_value,
            method = "BH"
        )
    )
